subject: FinTrust: Request for KMS/HSM evidence and SOC 2 attachments
messages:
From: Anna Li <security@fintrust.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Samuel Park <sam.park@fintrust.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KMS/HSM evidence request for SOC 2 review

Jordan —

Thanks for the quick onboarding call earlier. As part of our SOC 2 scoping we need a compact evidence bundle around your encryption/key management posture. Can you provide the following items (or point to a secure drop):

1) HSM vendor and attestation: latest HSM attestation report (hardware model + date of attestation).
2) KMS configuration: confirmation whether customer keys are tenant BYOK, provider-managed, or mixed; KMS provider and region(s).
3) Rotation logs: sample rotation logs showing at least two rotation events for tenant KEKs in the past 12 months (UTC timestamps).
4) Access matrix: list of operator roles that can perform key import/export/rotation, and evidence of recent operator role reviews.
5) Transit & at-rest: cipher suites used for TLS termination (min versions) and disk/encryption-at-rest configuration for model-serving volumes.

We prefer CSV or structured exports for rotation logs and a signed PDF for the HSM attestation. If anything is sensitive, send to our secure upload link (attachments or SFTP) — we can provide a temporary token.

Target: SOC 2 evidence package due by 2029-06-07. Please flag anything that will take longer.

Best,
Anna Li
Lead InfoSec Analyst, FinTrust
security@fintrust.com

Attachments: SIG-questionnaire-FinTrust.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <security@fintrust.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 01 Jun 2029 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM evidence request for SOC 2 review

Anna —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Looping in Irene (Security/Compliance) and Marissa (Customer Success) to assemble the package. Quick notes:

- We have an HSM-backed KEK layer (Thales/HSM) for tenant BYOK flows and provider-managed keys for most internal-only artifacts.
- Rotation events are recorded in our KMS telemetry — we can export a CSV with timestamps and operator IDs.
- TLS cipher policy: we enforce TLS 1.2+ but default is TLS 1.3 on all public endpoints; we will include exact cipher suites.

Irene — can your team prepare the attestation PDF and a redacted operator matrix? Marissa — can you coordinate secure upload to FinTrust's token (or we can share an SFTP link)?

I'll compile the day-by-day plan and target the 2029-06-06 internal delivery so you have time to review.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
+1 (415) 555-0102
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Anna Li <security@fintrust.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 02 Jun 2029 11:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM evidence request for SOC 2 review

Anna / Jordan —

We pulled the initial artifacts and have a small set of items ready for secure delivery. Summary of what we'll provide in the bundle:

- hsm-attestation-2028-11.pdf (redacted serials): vendor: Thales nShield CN6000; attestation performed by third-party lab on 2028-11-09.
- kms-rotation-sample-2029Q1.csv: example rows include rotation_timestamp_utc, key_id, previous_key_fingerprint, new_key_fingerprint, operator_id, change_request_id.
- operator_role_matrix.csv: role_name, allowed_actions (import/export/rotate), last_review_date, reviewer.
- tls_cipher_policy.txt: explicit list of enabled ciphers and TLS minimum version for our public API and internal control plane.
- README.txt: short narrative mapping artifacts to your questions and SOC 2 trust services criteria references.

Notes/controls to call out in README:
- BYOK: customer-managed keys are supported via tenant BYOK using HSM-wrapped imports; we never store cleartext tenant private keys in the control plane.
- Rotation policy: KEKs rotated annually by default; emergency rotations follow our incident runbook with cryptographic rollback protections.
- Access: only two named operator roles (KMS-Operator, Crypto-Engineer) can perform import/export/rotation; tiered approvals are enforced via a signed change request system (internal ticket id included in CSV rows).

For sharing: we can upload to the FinTrust secure upload if you send the token. Alternatively, we'll place files in a temporary Google Drive folder and share a short-lived link; please confirm which you prefer.

Attaching the three small items inline for your review (we'll remove identifying metadata from the sample rotation CSV):

Attachments referenced: hsm-attestation-2028-11.pdf, kms-rotation-sample-2029Q1.csv, operator_role_matrix.csv

Irene Choi
Head of Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
From: Samuel Park <sam.park@fintrust.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Jun 2029 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: KMS/HSM evidence request for SOC 2 review

Irene / Jordan —

Appreciate the rapid response and the level of detail. Two quick follow-ups after a brief review:

1) Can you include the change-request IDs (redacted) that map to the two rotation events in the CSV so our audit path lines up with your ticketing system?
2) For the HSM attestation PDF — please confirm whether the attestation included key extraction resistance testing (we usually label that in the PDF and it was not obvious in your redacted copy).

Prefer secure upload token: I'll generate a single-use token and email it to Jordan by EOD — please use that link rather than Drive for PII minimization.

If you can send the updated CSV and the attestation comment by tomorrow (2029-06-04), we should be good for our SOC 2 package submission on 2029-06-07.

Thanks,
Samuel Park
Senior InfoSec Auditor, FinTrust
